source.text: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶה֙ מָק֣וֹר נִפְתָּ֔ח לְבֵ֥ית דָּוִ֖יד וּלְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לְחַטַּ֖את וּלְנִדָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: On that day there will be a fountain opened for [the] house of David and for [the] inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for impurity.

en.L: In that day there will be a fountain opened for the house of David and for the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for impurity.
en.B: On that day a fountain will be opened for the house of David and the people of Jerusalem, to wash away their sin and impurity.
en.R: At that time a spring will be opened for the family of David and the people of Jerusalem. Its water will wash away their sin and make them clean.

es.L: En aquel día habrá un manantial abierto para la casa de David y para los habitantes de Jerusalén, para el pecado y para la impureza.
es.B: Aquel día se abrirá un manantial para la casa de David y para los habitantes de Jerusalén, para lavar su pecado y su impureza.
es.R: En ese tiempo se abrirá una fuente para la familia de David y para la gente de Jerusalén. Su agua lavará su pecado y los dejará limpios.

fr.L: En ce jour-là, il y aura une source ouverte pour la maison de David et pour les habitants de Jérusalem, pour le péché et pour l’impureté.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, une source sera ouverte pour la maison de David et les habitants de Jérusalem, pour laver leur péché et leur impureté.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, une source sera ouverte pour la famille de David et les habitants de Jérusalem. Son eau lavera leur péché et les rendra purs.

sw.L: Katika siku ile kutakuwa na chemchemi iliyofunguliwa kwa ajili ya nyumba ya Daudi na kwa ajili ya wakaaji wa Yerusalemu, kwa ajili ya dhambi na kwa ajili ya unajisi.
sw.B: Siku hiyo chemchemi itafunguliwa kwa ajili ya nyumba ya Daudi na watu wa Yerusalemu, ili kuosha dhambi yao na unajisi wao.
sw.R: Wakati huo chemchemi itafunguliwa kwa ajili ya jamaa ya Daudi na watu wa Yerusalemu. Maji yake yataosha dhambi zao na kuwafanya safi.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy sẽ có một nguồn nước mở ra cho nhà Đa-vít và cho dân cư Giê-ru-sa-lem, vì tội lỗi và vì sự ô uế.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, một nguồn nước sẽ được mở ra cho nhà Đa-vít và dân cư Giê-ru-sa-lem, để tẩy sạch tội lỗi và sự ô uế của họ.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, một dòng suối sẽ được mở ra cho dòng họ Đa-vít và dân Giê-ru-sa-lem. Nước suối ấy sẽ rửa sạch tội lỗi họ và làm cho họ được tinh sạch.

ko.L: 그날에 다윗 집과 예루살렘 주민들을 위하여, 죄와 부정을 위하여 열린 샘이 있을 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에 다윗 집과 예루살렘 주민들을 위하여 샘이 열려, 그들의 죄와 부정을 씻을 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 다윗 집안과 예루살렘 사람들을 위해 샘이 하나 열릴 것이다. 그 물이 그들의 죄를 씻어 내고 그들을 깨끗하게 할 것이다.

decisions.choice: a fountain for sin and for impurity: water that cleanses
decisions.reason: The law used water to cleanse from uncleanness: "water for impurity", mixed with the ashes of a red heifer, cleansed those who had touched a dead body (Numbers 19:9-21). The word for "impurity" is the one used there; it also means the uncleanness of a woman's monthly period (Leviticus 15:19-24) and, in the prophets, the uncleanness of sin and idol worship (Ezekiel 36:17). Here God opens a spring that never runs dry, for cleansing from sin itself.

decisions.choice: on that day ... a fountain opened: the people who mourned in 12:10-14 are cleansed
decisions.reason: The same house of David and people of Jerusalem who mourned for the one they pierced (12:10) are now given cleansing. Ezekiel 36:25 promises, "I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean", and the picture of water flowing from Jerusalem returns in 14:8 (compare Ezekiel 47:1-12; Joel 4:18).

decisions.choice: to wash away (B); Its water will wash away ... make them clean (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "for sin and for impurity". Balanced and Readable say what the fountain is for (m1).

source.text: וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא נְאֻ֣ם׀יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת אַכְרִ֞ית אֶת־שְׁמ֤וֹת הָֽעֲצַבִּים֙ מִן־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְלֹ֥א יִזָּכְר֖וּ ע֑וֹד וְגַ֧ם אֶת־הַנְּבִיאִ֛ים וְאֶת־ר֥וּחַ הַטֻּמְאָ֖ה אַעֲבִ֥יר מִן־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be on that day, declaration of Yahweh of hosts, [that] I will cut off the names of the idols from the land, and they will not be remembered again; and also the prophets and the spirit of the uncleanness I will cause to pass from the land.

en.L: And it will be in that day, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, [that] I will cut off the idols' names from the land, and they will not be remembered again; and also the prophets and the spirit of uncleanness I will remove from the land.
en.B: On that day, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, I will wipe out the names of the idols from the land, and no one will remember them any more. The prophets too, and the spirit of impurity, I will remove from the land.
en.R: At that time, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, I will get rid of the idols in the land, and no one will even remember their names. I will also remove the false prophets from the land, and the spirit that makes people unclean.

es.L: Y sucederá en aquel día, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, [que] cortaré de la tierra los nombres de los ídolos, y no serán recordados más; y también a los profetas y al espíritu de impureza quitaré de la tierra.
es.B: Aquel día, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, borraré de la tierra los nombres de los ídolos, y nadie volverá a recordarlos. También a los profetas y al espíritu de impureza los quitaré de la tierra.
es.R: En ese tiempo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, acabaré con los ídolos de la tierra, y nadie recordará ni siquiera sus nombres. También quitaré de la tierra a los falsos profetas y al espíritu que hace impura a la gente.

fr.L: Et il arrivera en ce jour-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, [que] je retrancherai du pays les noms des idoles, et on ne s’en souviendra plus ; et aussi les prophètes et l’esprit d’impureté, je les ferai disparaître du pays.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, j’effacerai du pays les noms des idoles, et personne ne s’en souviendra plus. Les prophètes aussi, et l’esprit d’impureté, je les ôterai du pays.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, je supprimerai les idoles du pays, et personne ne se souviendra même plus de leurs noms. J’ôterai aussi du pays les faux prophètes et l’esprit qui rend les gens impurs.

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika siku ile, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, nitayakatilia mbali majina ya sanamu katika nchi, wala hayatakumbukwa tena; na pia manabii na roho ya uchafu nitawaondoa katika nchi.
sw.B: Siku hiyo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, nitayafuta majina ya sanamu katika nchi, wala hakuna atakayeyakumbuka tena. Manabii pia, na roho ya unajisi, nitawaondoa katika nchi.
sw.R: Wakati huo, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, nitaziondoa sanamu katika nchi, na hakuna atakayekumbuka hata majina ya sanamu hizo. Nitawaondoa pia manabii wa uongo katika nchi, pamoja na roho inayowafanya watu kuwa najisi.

vi.L: Sẽ xảy ra trong ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ diệt trừ danh của các thần tượng khỏi xứ, và chúng sẽ không còn được nhớ đến nữa; cả các tiên tri lẫn thần ô uế, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ khiến biến khỏi xứ.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ xóa bỏ danh các thần tượng khỏi xứ, và không ai còn nhớ đến chúng nữa. Cả các tiên tri lẫn thần ô uế, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ dẹp bỏ khỏi xứ.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ dẹp sạch các thần tượng trong xứ, và không ai còn nhớ đến cả tên của chúng nữa. Ta cũng sẽ dẹp khỏi xứ các tiên tri giả và thần làm cho người ta ô uế.

ko.L: 그날에 이렇게 될 것이다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 내가 그 땅에서 우상들의 이름을 끊어 버려서, 다시는 그것들이 기억되지 않을 것이다. 또 예언자들과 더러운 영도 내가 그 땅에서 없애겠다.
ko.B: 그날에 내가 이 땅에서 우상들의 이름을 지워 버려, 아무도 다시는 그것들을 기억하지 못하게 하겠다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 예언자들과 더러운 영도 내가 이 땅에서 없애겠다.
ko.R: 그때에 내가 이 땅에서 우상들을 없애 버려서, 아무도 그 이름조차 기억하지 못하게 하겠다. 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 거짓 예언자들과 사람들을 더럽게 만드는 영도 내가 이 땅에서 없애겠다.

decisions.choice: cut off the names of the idols, and they will not be remembered: idol worship will end completely
decisions.reason: To call on a god's name was to worship it. Israel was told not even to mention the names of other gods (Exodus 23:13), and Hosea 2:19 promises that the names of the Baals will be forgotten. When the names are no longer spoken, the worship is gone.

decisions.choice: the prophets: those who prophesy falsely
decisions.reason: The prophets removed here are named with the idols and "the spirit of uncleanness", and verses 3-6 show that they speak lies in the LORD's name. They are false prophets, like those Jeremiah opposed (Jeremiah 23:9-40; 27:9-10). The Hebrew does not add "false"; the context makes it plain.

decisions.choice: the spirit of uncleanness: the power behind false prophecy and idol worship
decisions.reason: It stands against the "spirit of grace" the LORD pours out in 12:10. 1 Kings 22:22-23 tells of a "lying spirit" in the mouths of prophets. The LORD will remove the spirit that made his people unclean, as the fountain of verse 1 washes them.

decisions.choice: And it will be in that day, declares the LORD of hosts (L); On that day, declares the LORD of Armies (B); At that time, says the LORD of Armies (R); false prophets (R)
decisions.reason: The formulas follow the wording set in Isaiah. Readable adds "false" to make plain which prophets are meant (m2).

source.text: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּֽי־יִנָּבֵ֣א אִישׁ֮ עוֹד֒ וְאָמְר֣וּ אֵ֠לָיו אָבִ֨יו וְאִמּ֤וֹ יֹֽלְדָיו֙ לֹ֣א תִֽחְיֶ֔ה כִּ֛י שֶׁ֥קֶר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וּדְקָרֻ֜הוּ אָבִ֧יהוּ וְאִמּ֛וֹ יֹלְדָ֖יו בְּהִנָּבְאֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be, if prophesies a man again, then will say to him his father and his mother who bore him, You will not live, for falsehood you have spoken in [the] name of Yahweh; and will pierce him his father and his mother who bore him when he prophesies.

en.L: And it will be, if anyone prophesies again, his father and his mother who bore him will say to him, "You shall not live, for you have spoken falsehood in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}"; then his father and his mother who bore him will pierce him through when he prophesies.
en.B: If anyone still prophesies, his own father and mother will say to him, "You must not live, because you have spoken lies in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}." And when he prophesies, his own father and mother will run him through.
en.R: If anyone still claims to speak for God, his own parents will say to him, "You must die, because you have told lies and said they came from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}." And when he prophesies, his own father and mother will stab him to death.

es.L: Y sucederá que si alguno profetiza todavía, le dirán su padre y su madre que lo engendraron: «No vivirás, porque has hablado mentira en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}»; y su padre y su madre que lo engendraron lo traspasarán cuando profetice.
es.B: Si alguien sigue profetizando, su propio padre y su propia madre le dirán: «No debes vivir, porque has dicho mentiras en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}». Y cuando profetice, su propio padre y su propia madre lo traspasarán.
es.R: Si alguien todavía dice que habla de parte de Dios, sus propios padres le dirán: «Tienes que morir, porque has dicho mentiras y has dicho que venían {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}». Y cuando profetice, su propio padre y su propia madre lo matarán a puñaladas.

fr.L: Et il arrivera que si quelqu’un prophétise encore, son père et sa mère qui l’ont engendré lui diront : « Tu ne vivras pas, car tu as dit le mensonge au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} » ; et son père et sa mère qui l’ont engendré le transperceront quand il prophétisera.
fr.B: Si quelqu’un prophétise encore, son propre père et sa propre mère lui diront : « Tu ne dois pas vivre, car tu as dit des mensonges au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. » Et quand il prophétisera, son propre père et sa propre mère le transperceront.
fr.R: Si quelqu’un prétend encore parler de la part de Dieu, ses propres parents lui diront : « Tu dois mourir, car tu as dit des mensonges en prétendant qu’ils venaient {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. » Et quand il prophétisera, son propre père et sa propre mère le poignarderont.

sw.L: Na itakuwa, kama mtu yeyote atatabiri tena, baba yake na mama yake waliomzaa watamwambia, "Hutaishi, kwa maana umesema uongo kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}"; kisha baba yake na mama yake waliomzaa watamtoboa atakapotabiri.
sw.B: Mtu yeyote akiendelea kutabiri, baba yake na mama yake mwenyewe watamwambia, "Hupaswi kuishi, kwa sababu umesema uongo kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}." Na atakapotabiri, baba yake na mama yake mwenyewe watamtoboa.
sw.R: Mtu yeyote akiendelea kudai kwamba anasema kwa niaba ya Mungu, wazazi wake mwenyewe watamwambia, "Lazima ufe, kwa sababu umesema uongo na kudai kwamba ulitoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}." Na atakapotabiri, baba yake na mama yake mwenyewe watamchoma kwa upanga hadi afe.

vi.L: Sẽ xảy ra, nếu có ai còn nói tiên tri, thì cha và mẹ đã sinh ra nó sẽ nói với nó: "Con sẽ không được sống, vì con đã nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà nói điều giả dối"; rồi cha và mẹ đã sinh ra nó sẽ đâm nó khi nó nói tiên tri.
vi.B: Nếu ai còn nói tiên tri, chính cha mẹ ruột của nó sẽ nói với nó: "Con không được sống, vì con đã nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà nói dối." Và khi nó nói tiên tri, chính cha mẹ ruột sẽ đâm nó.
vi.R: Nếu ai còn tự xưng là nói thay cho Đức Chúa Trời, chính cha mẹ nó sẽ bảo nó: "Con phải chết, vì con đã nói dối và bảo rằng đó là lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}." Và khi nó nói tiên tri, chính cha mẹ nó sẽ đâm chết nó.

ko.L: 누구든지 다시 예언하면, 그를 낳은 그의 아버지와 어머니가 그에게 "너는 살지 못할 것이다. 네가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 거짓을 말하였기 때문이다" 하고 말할 것이다. 그리고 그가 예언할 때에 그를 낳은 그의 아버지와 어머니가 그를 찌를 것이다.
ko.B: 누구든지 여전히 예언하면, 그를 낳은 아버지와 어머니가 "너는 살아서는 안 된다. 네가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 거짓말을 했기 때문이다" 하고 말할 것이다. 그리고 그가 예언할 때에 그를 낳은 아버지와 어머니가 그를 찌를 것이다.
ko.R: 누구든지 아직도 하나님의 말씀을 전한다고 하면, 그의 부모가 그에게 "너는 죽어야 한다. 네가 거짓말을 하고 그것이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하신 말씀이라고 했기 때문이다" 하고 말할 것이다. 그가 예언할 때에 그의 아버지와 어머니가 그를 찔러 죽일 것이다.

decisions.choice: his father and his mother will say, You shall not live: the law on false prophets
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 13:7-12 and 18:20 say that a prophet who speaks in the name of other gods, or claims to speak in the LORD's name what he has not commanded, must die, and that no one, not even a close relative, may shield him. Here the false prophet's own parents carry out the law. Their loyalty to the LORD will outweigh even their love for their son.

decisions.choice: pierce him through: the verb of 12:10
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used in 12:10, "the one they pierced". The parents run their son through with a sword or spear. The picture is extreme, and it shows how completely false prophecy will be rejected on that day.

decisions.choice: his own father and mother (B); his own parents (R); run him through (B); stab him to death (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "his own" to bring out the force of "who bore him", and leave out the repeated phrase the second time. Readable says "claims to speak for God" for "prophesies" at the start, and "You must die" for "You shall not live". The man is a son of his father and mother, so no gender setting is used.

decisions.choice: "lo traspasarán" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The verb of 12:10 (meaning decision m2), kept with the same Spanish word, "traspasar", so the link can be seen; Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: "le transperceront" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The verb of 12:10 (meaning decision m2), with the same French word, "transpercer".

decisions.choice: "watamtoboa" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The verb of 12:10 (meaning decision m2), with the same Swahili word, "kutoboa".

decisions.choice: "con" from the parents to their son; "nó" for the false prophet; "đâm" as in 12:10
decisions.reason: Parents speak to a son as "con"; the false prophet is a guilty figure and is "nó" in the oracle. "Đâm" keeps the verb of 12:10 (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: "그를 찌를 것이다" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The verb of 12:10 (meaning decision m2), with the same Korean word, "찌르다"; Readable adds "죽일" as the English Readable does.

source.text: וְהָיָ֣ה׀בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יֵבֹ֧שׁוּ הַנְּבִיאִ֛ים אִ֥ישׁ מֵחֶזְיֹנ֖וֹ בְּהִנָּֽבְאֹת֑וֹ וְלֹ֧א יִלְבְּשׁ֛וּ אַדֶּ֥רֶת שֵׂעָ֖ר לְמַ֥עַן כַּחֵֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be on that day [that] will be ashamed the prophets, each of his vision when he prophesies; and they will not put on a cloak of hair in order to deceive.

en.L: And it will be in that day [that] the prophets will be ashamed, each of his vision when he prophesies; and they will not put on a hairy cloak in order to deceive.
en.B: On that day every prophet will be ashamed of the vision he prophesies, and they will not put on a prophet's hairy cloak to deceive people.
en.R: At that time the prophets will be ashamed of their visions and of what they say. They will no longer wear a prophet's coat made of hair to trick people.

es.L: Y sucederá en aquel día [que] los profetas se avergonzarán, cada uno de su visión cuando profetice; y no se pondrán el manto de pelo para engañar.
es.B: Aquel día todo profeta se avergonzará de la visión que profetiza, y no se pondrán el manto de pelo de profeta para engañar a la gente.
es.R: En ese tiempo los profetas se avergonzarán de sus visiones y de lo que dicen. Ya no se pondrán la capa de pelo de los profetas para engañar a la gente.

fr.L: Et il arrivera en ce jour-là [que] les prophètes auront honte, chacun de sa vision quand il prophétisera ; et ils ne revêtiront pas le manteau de poil pour tromper.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, chaque prophète aura honte de la vision qu’il prophétise, et ils ne mettront plus le manteau de poil des prophètes pour tromper les gens.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, les prophètes auront honte de leurs visions et de ce qu’ils disent. Ils ne porteront plus le manteau de poil des prophètes pour tromper les gens.

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika siku ile, manabii wataona aibu, kila mmoja kwa maono yake atakapotabiri; wala hawatavaa vazi la manyoya ili kudanganya.
sw.B: Siku hiyo kila nabii ataona aibu kwa maono anayoyatabiri, wala hawatavaa vazi la manyoya la nabii ili kuwadanganya watu.
sw.R: Wakati huo manabii wataona aibu kwa maono yao na kwa yale wanayosema. Hawatavaa tena koti la nabii lililotengenezwa kwa manyoya ili kuwadanganya watu.

vi.L: Sẽ xảy ra trong ngày ấy, các tiên tri sẽ hổ thẹn, mỗi người về khải tượng của mình khi nói tiên tri; và chúng sẽ không mặc áo choàng bằng lông để lừa dối.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, mỗi tiên tri sẽ hổ thẹn về khải tượng mình nói ra, và chúng sẽ không mặc áo choàng lông của tiên tri để lừa gạt người ta nữa.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, các tiên tri sẽ xấu hổ về những khải tượng và những điều chúng nói. Chúng sẽ không còn mặc áo choàng bằng lông của tiên tri để lừa gạt người ta nữa.

ko.L: 그날에 이렇게 될 것이다. 예언자들이 각각 예언할 때에 자기 환상을 부끄러워할 것이며, 속이려고 털옷을 입지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에는 예언자마다 자기가 예언하는 환상을 부끄러워할 것이며, 사람들을 속이려고 예언자의 털옷을 입지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에는 예언자들이 자기들이 본 환상과 자기들이 한 말을 부끄러워할 것이다. 그들은 더 이상 사람들을 속이려고 예언자들이 입는 털옷을 입지 않을 것이다.

decisions.choice: a hairy cloak: the dress of a prophet
decisions.reason: Elijah was known by his hairy garment and leather belt (2 Kings 1:8), and his cloak passed to Elisha (1 Kings 19:19; 2 Kings 2:13-14). John the Baptist dressed the same way (Matthew 3:4). False prophets wore it to look like true ones. The word for cloak is the one translated "glory" in 11:3.

decisions.choice: the prophets will be ashamed, each of his vision: they will not want to be known as prophets
decisions.reason: On that day the false prophets will be ashamed of their visions and will hide that they ever were prophets, as verses 5-6 show.

decisions.choice: a prophet's hairy cloak (B); a prophet's coat made of hair (R); to deceive people (B); to trick people (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say whose cloak it was (m1) and whom the prophets deceive. Readable makes the visions plural, "their visions".

source.text: וְאָמַ֕ר לֹ֥א נָבִ֖יא אָנֹ֑כִי אִישׁ־עֹבֵ֤ד אֲדָמָה֙ אָנֹ֔כִי כִּ֥י אָדָ֖ם הִקְנַ֥נִי מִנְּעוּרָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And he will say, Not a prophet [am] I; a man working [the] ground [am] I, for a man acquired me from my youth.

en.L: And he will say, "I [am] not a prophet; I [am] a man who works the ground, for a man bought me in my youth."
en.B: Each will say, "I am no prophet. I work the soil; I was sold to a man as a servant when I was young."
en.R: Each of them will say, "I am not a prophet. I am a farmer. Someone bought me as a servant when I was young, and I have worked the land ever since."

es.L: Y dirá: «No [soy] profeta yo; un hombre que trabaja la tierra [soy] yo, porque un hombre me compró en mi juventud».
es.B: Cada uno dirá: «Yo no soy profeta. Trabajo la tierra; desde joven me vendieron a un hombre como siervo».
es.R: Cada uno de ellos dirá: «Yo no soy profeta. Soy agricultor. Alguien me compró como siervo cuando yo era joven, y desde entonces he trabajado la tierra».

fr.L: Et il dira : « Je [ne suis] pas prophète, moi ; un homme qui travaille la terre, [voilà ce que je suis], moi, car un homme m’a acheté dès ma jeunesse. »
fr.B: Chacun dira : « Je ne suis pas prophète. Je cultive la terre ; on m’a vendu comme serviteur à un homme quand j’étais jeune. »
fr.R: Chacun d’eux dira : « Je ne suis pas prophète. Je suis paysan. Quelqu’un m’a acheté comme serviteur quand j’étais jeune, et depuis, je travaille la terre. »

sw.L: Naye atasema, "Mimi si nabii; mimi [ni] mtu alimaye ardhi, kwa maana mtu alininunua tangu ujana wangu."
sw.B: Kila mmoja atasema, "Mimi si nabii. Mimi ni mkulima; niliuzwa kwa mtu kuwa mtumishi nilipokuwa kijana."
sw.R: Kila mmoja wao atasema, "Mimi si nabii. Mimi ni mkulima. Mtu fulani alininunua kuwa mtumishi nilipokuwa kijana, na tangu wakati huo nimekuwa nikilima ardhi."

vi.L: Nó sẽ nói: "Tôi không [phải là] tiên tri; tôi [là] người làm ruộng, vì có người đã mua tôi từ thuở thiếu thời."
vi.B: Mỗi người sẽ nói: "Tôi không phải là tiên tri. Tôi làm ruộng; từ nhỏ tôi đã bị bán làm đầy tớ cho người ta."
vi.R: Mỗi người trong bọn họ sẽ nói: "Tôi không phải là tiên tri. Tôi là nông dân. Có người đã mua tôi về làm đầy tớ khi tôi còn trẻ, và từ đó đến nay tôi làm ruộng."

ko.L: 그가 말할 것이다. "나는 예언자가 아니오. 나는 땅을 가는 사람이오. 어떤 사람이 어려서부터 나를 샀기 때문이오."
ko.B: 저마다 이렇게 말할 것이다. "나는 예언자가 아니오. 나는 농사꾼이오. 어려서 남의 종으로 팔려 왔소."
ko.R: 그들은 저마다 이렇게 말할 것이다. "나는 예언자가 아니오. 나는 농부요. 어려서 누가 나를 종으로 사 갔고, 그 뒤로 줄곧 땅을 갈아 왔소."

decisions.choice: I am not a prophet: the words of Amos, used to deny the calling
decisions.reason: Amos told the priest of Bethel, "I am not a prophet, nor a member of a company of prophets; I am a herdsman" (Amos 7:14). Amos meant that the LORD had called him from his work. The false prophet uses the same words to hide what he had been.

decisions.choice: a man bought me in my youth: following the Hebrew text
alternatives: the land has been my possession since my youth
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "a man acquired me (as a servant) from my youth". He claims that he has always worked the land for a master, and so had no time to be a prophet. Some read the same letters as "the ground has been my possession from my youth", that is, "I have been a farmer all my life". The sense is close either way.

decisions.choice: Each will say (B); Each of them will say (R); as a servant (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "each" for the singular "he", since verse 4 speaks of every prophet, and add "as a servant" to explain "bought me" (m2).

decisions.choice: 하오체 ("아니오", "사람이오") for the former prophet's answers in verses 5-6
decisions.reason: He answers someone who questions him, as one adult to another; 하오체 is the plain but civil level for such an exchange.

source.text: וְאָמַ֣ר אֵלָ֔יו מָ֧ה הַמַּכּ֛וֹת הָאֵ֖לֶּה בֵּ֣ין יָדֶ֑יךָ וְאָמַ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֻכֵּ֖יתִי בֵּ֥ית מְאַהֲבָֽי׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And [one] will say to him, What [are] the wounds these between your hands? And he will say, [Those with] which I was struck [at the] house of my friends.

en.L: And [someone] will say to him, "What [are] these wounds between your hands?" And he will say, "[Those] with which I was struck [in] the house of my friends."
en.B: And if someone asks him, "Then what are these wounds on your chest?" he will answer, "I got them in the house of my friends."
en.R: If someone asks him, "Then what are these wounds on your chest?" he will say, "I was hurt at my friends' house."

es.L: Y [alguien] le dirá: «¿Qué [son] estas heridas entre tus manos?». Y él dirá: «[Las] que recibí [en] la casa de mis amigos».
es.B: Y si alguien le pregunta: «¿Qué son, entonces, esas heridas que tienes en el pecho?», responderá: «Me las hicieron en casa de mis amigos».
es.R: Si alguien le pregunta: «¿Y qué son esas heridas que tienes en el pecho?», él dirá: «Me lastimaron en casa de mis amigos».

fr.L: Et [quelqu’un] lui dira : « Que [sont] ces blessures entre tes mains ? » Et il dira : « [Celles] dont j’ai été frappé [dans] la maison de mes amis. »
fr.B: Et si quelqu’un lui demande : « Mais alors, que sont ces blessures sur ta poitrine ? », il répondra : « Je les ai reçues dans la maison de mes amis. »
fr.R: Si quelqu’un lui demande : « Alors, qu’est-ce que c’est que ces blessures sur ta poitrine ? », il dira : « On m’a blessé chez mes amis. »

sw.L: Na [mtu] atamwambia, "Majeraha haya [ni nini] katikati ya mikono yako?" Naye atasema, "[Ni yale] niliyopigwa [katika] nyumba ya rafiki zangu."
sw.B: Na mtu akimwuliza, "Basi majeraha haya kifuani mwako ni ya nini?" atajibu, "Niliyapata katika nyumba ya rafiki zangu."
sw.R: Mtu akimwuliza, "Basi majeraha haya kifuani mwako ni ya nini?" atasema, "Niliumizwa nyumbani kwa rafiki zangu."

vi.L: Và [có người] sẽ hỏi nó: "Những vết thương giữa hai tay ông là gì?" Nó sẽ đáp: "[Đó là những vết] tôi bị đánh [trong] nhà bạn hữu tôi."
vi.B: Nếu có người hỏi nó: "Vậy những vết thương trên ngực ông là gì?" thì nó sẽ đáp: "Tôi bị thương tại nhà bạn hữu tôi."
vi.R: Nếu có ai hỏi nó: "Thế những vết thương trên ngực ông là gì?" thì nó sẽ nói: "Tôi bị thương ở nhà bạn bè tôi."

ko.L: 누가 그에게 "당신의 두 손 사이에 있는 이 상처들은 무엇이오?" 하고 물으면, 그는 "내 친구들의 집에서 맞은 [상처]요" 하고 말할 것이다.
ko.B: 누가 그에게 "그러면 당신 가슴에 있는 이 상처들은 무엇이오?" 하고 물으면, 그는 "내 친구들의 집에서 다친 것이오" 하고 대답할 것이다.
ko.R: 누가 그에게 "그러면 당신 가슴에 난 이 상처들은 뭐요?" 하고 물으면, 그는 "친구들 집에서 다쳤소" 하고 말할 것이다.

decisions.choice: wounds between your hands: wounds on the chest or back
decisions.reason: "Between the hands" means the body between the arms, the chest or the back (2 Kings 9:24 uses the phrase of an arrow that struck the king between his shoulders). Prophets of Baal cut themselves in their frenzy (1 Kings 18:28), and the law forbade such cutting (Leviticus 19:28; Deuteronomy 14:1). The scars would give away that the man had been such a prophet.

decisions.choice: in the house of my friends: an excuse, perhaps a pun
decisions.reason: The man explains his scars as wounds from a quarrel among friends. The word for "friends" means "those who love me", and the prophets use it of the lovers Israel ran after, its false gods (Hosea 2:7; Jeremiah 22:20), so the excuse may give away the truth.

decisions.choice: the wounds of a false prophet, not a prophecy of Christ
decisions.reason: Older translations read "wounds in your hands", and some Christian readers took the verse as a prophecy of the wounds of Christ. In its setting the speaker is a false prophet who denies what he has been (verses 4-5), and his wounds are on his body, not his hands. The New Testament does not quote this verse. The next verse turns to the LORD's shepherd.

decisions.choice: on your chest (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of "between your hands" (m1). Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase.

source.text: חֶ֗רֶב עוּרִ֤י עַל־רֹעִי֙ וְעַל־גֶּ֣בֶר עֲמִיתִ֔י נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת הַ֤ךְ אֶת־הָֽרֹעֶה֙ וּתְפוּצֶ֣יןָ הַצֹּ֔אן וַהֲשִׁבֹתִ֥י יָדִ֖י עַל־הַצֹּעֲרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Sword, awake against my shepherd, and against [the] man [who is] my associate, declaration of Yahweh of hosts. Strike the shepherd, and will be scattered the sheep; and I will turn my hand against the little ones.

en.L: Sword, awake against {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} shepherd, and against the man [who is] {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} associate, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts. \q Strike the shepherd, and let the sheep be scattered; \q and I will turn {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand upon the small ones.
en.B: Awake, sword, against {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} shepherd, against the man who stands next to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. \q Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will scatter; \q I will turn {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand against even the little ones.
en.R: Sword, wake up and attack {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} shepherd, the man who is close to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. \q Kill the shepherd, and the sheep will run off in every direction. \q I will turn against even the weakest of the flock.

es.L: ¡Espada, despierta contra {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pastor, y contra el hombre [que es] {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} compañero!, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos. \q Golpea al pastor, y que se dispersen las ovejas; \q y volveré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano contra los pequeños.
es.B: ¡Despierta, espada, contra {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pastor, contra el hombre que está a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} lado!, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. \q Golpea al pastor, y que se dispersen las ovejas; \q volveré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano aun contra los pequeños.
es.R: ¡Espada, despierta y ataca a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pastor, al hombre que está cerca de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}!, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. \q Mata al pastor, y las ovejas huirán en todas direcciones. \q Me volveré aun contra las más débiles del rebaño.

fr.L: Épée, réveille-toi contre {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} berger, et contre l’homme [qui est] {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} compagnon, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. \q Frappe le berger, et que les brebis soient dispersées ; \q et je tournerai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main contre les petits.
fr.B: Réveille-toi, épée, contre {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} berger, contre l’homme qui se tient à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} côtés, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. \q Frappe le berger, et les brebis seront dispersées ; \q je tournerai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main même contre les petits.
fr.R: Épée, réveille-toi et attaque {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} berger, l’homme qui est proche de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. \q Tue le berger, et les moutons s’enfuiront de tous côtés. \q Je me tournerai même contre les plus faibles du troupeau.

sw.L: Upanga, amka juu ya mchungaji {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, na juu ya mtu [aliye] mwenzangu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. \q Mpige mchungaji, na kondoo watawanyike; \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaugeuza mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu ya wadogo.
sw.B: Amka, ee upanga, dhidi ya mchungaji {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, dhidi ya mtu aliye karibu {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. \q Mpige mchungaji, na kondoo watatawanyika; \q nitaugeuza mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} hata dhidi ya wadogo.
sw.R: Upanga, amka umshambulie mchungaji {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, mtu aliye karibu {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}}, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. \q Muue mchungaji, na kondoo watakimbia pande zote. \q Nitawageukia hata walio dhaifu kuliko wote katika kundi.

vi.L: Hỡi gươm, hãy thức dậy nghịch cùng người chăn của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và nghịch cùng người [là] bạn đồng hành của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy. \q Hãy đánh người chăn, thì chiên sẽ tan lạc; \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trở tay nghịch cùng những con nhỏ.
vi.B: Hỡi gươm, hãy thức dậy nghịch cùng người chăn của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, nghịch cùng người đứng bên cạnh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy. \q Hãy đánh người chăn, thì chiên sẽ tan lạc; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trở tay nghịch lại cả những con nhỏ.
vi.R: Hỡi gươm, hãy thức dậy và tấn công người chăn của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, là người gần gũi với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán. \q Hãy giết người chăn, thì bầy chiên sẽ chạy tán loạn khắp nơi. \q Ta sẽ trở tay nghịch lại cả những con yếu nhất trong bầy.

ko.L: 칼아, 깨어나 내 목자를 대적하고, 내 동료인 사람을 대적하여라. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. \q 목자를 쳐라. 그러면 양들이 흩어질 것이다. \q 내가 작은 것들에게 내 손을 돌릴 것이다.
ko.B: 칼아, 깨어나 내 목자를, 내 곁에 있는 사람을 쳐라. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 목자를 쳐라. 그러면 양들이 흩어질 것이다. \q 내가 작은 것들에게까지 손을 돌릴 것이다.
ko.R: 칼아, 깨어나서 내 목자, 나와 가까운 그 사람을 쳐라. 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 목자를 죽여라. 그러면 양들이 사방으로 흩어질 것이다. \q 나는 양 떼 가운데 가장 약한 것들에게까지 손을 댈 것이다.

decisions.choice: Sword, awake against my shepherd: the LORD himself calls for his shepherd to be struck
decisions.reason: The LORD calls on the sword as if it were a person, as in Jeremiah 47:6. The shepherd is "my shepherd", one the LORD appointed. The verses do not say who he is. Many read him as the good shepherd rejected in 11:4-14, whom the people valued at thirty pieces of silver; some take him as the worthless shepherd of 11:17, and some move verses 7-9 to follow 11:17. "The man who is my associate" fits a shepherd close to the LORD better than a worthless one.

decisions.choice: the man who is my associate: one who stands beside the LORD as a near companion
decisions.reason: The word is rare. It is used in Leviticus for one's fellow or neighbor, a near equal (Leviticus 5:21; 19:11, 15; 25:14-17). Here it is the LORD who calls the shepherd his "associate", a man closely bound to him.

decisions.choice: I will turn my hand against the little ones: judgment that falls on the weak of the flock too
decisions.reason: To turn one's hand against someone is to act against them (Amos 1:8). The "little ones" are the young and weak of the flock (Jeremiah 49:20). When the shepherd is struck, the flock suffers too; verses 8-9 show that the judgment also refines a remnant. Isaiah 1:25 uses the same phrase for the LORD's purifying of his people.

decisions.choice: Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered: quoted by Jesus in Matthew 26:31 and Mark 14:27
decisions.reason: On the night of his arrest Jesus quotes these words of himself and his disciples, who will all leave him. In the Gospels' wording God himself says "I will strike the shepherd". In the Hebrew the LORD commands the sword to strike, so in both he is the one behind the striking.

decisions.choice: my shepherd, my associate, my hand (deity_pronoun setting); the shepherd (no setting)
decisions.reason: The LORD speaks of himself, so "my", "me" and "my hand" take the deity_pronoun setting. The shepherd takes none, as the pierced one of 12:10 and the king of 9:9 do not: the text does not settle who he is (m1).

decisions.choice: the man who stands next to me (B); the man who is close to me (R); Kill (R); run off in every direction (R); against even the weakest of the flock (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable explain "associate" (m2). Readable says "Kill" for "Strike", as the sword strikes to kill, and explains "the little ones" (m3). "Declares the LORD of hosts" follows the wording set in Isaiah.

decisions.choice: "Golpea al pastor, y que se dispersen las ovejas" (L, B); "Mata al pastor, y las ovejas huirán en todas direcciones" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for this verse: the Hebrew imperative is kept, while "pastor", "ovejas" and "dispersarse" / "en todas direcciones" are the words of the published Matthew 26:31 and Mark 14:27, whose "golpearé" / "heriré" comes from the Greek (meaning decision m4). The shepherd takes no deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: "Frappe le berger" (L, B); "Tue le berger" (R); "les brebis ... dispersées" (L, B); "les moutons s'enfuiront de tous côtés" (R)
decisions.reason: The key words of the published Matthew 26:31 and Mark 14:27 at each level, with the Hebrew imperative in place of the Gospels' "je frapperai", which comes from the Greek (meaning decision m4).

decisions.choice: "Mpige mchungaji" (L, B); "Muue mchungaji" (R); "kondoo watakimbia pande zote" (R)
decisions.reason: The words of the published Matthew 26:31 and Mark 14:27 ("mchungaji", "kondoo", "watatawanywa", "pande zote"), with the Hebrew imperative kept in place of the Gospels' "nitampiga" (meaning decision m4). "Mwenzangu" carries the possessive inside the word and takes no span.

decisions.choice: "Hãy đánh người chăn, thì chiên sẽ tan lạc" (L, B); "Hãy giết người chăn, thì bầy chiên sẽ chạy tán loạn khắp nơi" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording, with the words of the published Matthew 26:31 and Mark 14:27; the Hebrew imperative replaces the Gospels' "Ta sẽ đánh", which comes from the Greek (meaning decision m4). The shepherd takes no span.

decisions.choice: "목자를 쳐라. 그러면 양들이 흩어질 것이다" (L, B); "목자를 죽여라" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording: Matthew 26:31 and Mark 14:27 have the future "칠 것이니" from the Greek, and the Hebrew imperative is kept (meaning decision m4). The shepherd takes no -시-.

source.text: וְהָיָ֤ה בְכָל־הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה פִּֽי־שְׁנַ֣יִם בָּ֔הּ יִכָּרְת֖וּ יִגְוָ֑עוּ וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁ֖ית יִוָּ֥תֶר בָּֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be in all the land, declaration of Yahweh, [that] two portions in it will be cut off [and] perish, and the third will be left in it.

en.L: And it will be in all the land, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q [that] two parts in it will be cut off [and] perish, \q and the third will be left in it.
en.B: In the whole land, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q two-thirds will be cut off and die, \q but one-third will be left in it.
en.R: In the whole land, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q two out of every three people will be killed, \q and only one out of three will be left alive.

es.L: Y sucederá en toda la tierra, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q [que] dos partes en ella serán cortadas [y] perecerán, \q y la tercera quedará en ella.
es.B: En toda la tierra, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q dos terceras partes serán cortadas y morirán, \q pero una tercera parte quedará en ella.
es.R: En toda la tierra, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q dos de cada tres personas morirán, \q y solo una de cada tres quedará con vida.

fr.L: Et il arrivera dans tout le pays, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q [que] deux parts y seront retranchées [et] périront, \q et le tiers y sera laissé.
fr.B: Dans tout le pays, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q les deux tiers seront retranchés et mourront, \q mais un tiers y restera.
fr.R: Dans tout le pays, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q deux personnes sur trois seront tuées, \q et une seule sur trois restera en vie.

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika nchi yote, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q sehemu mbili ndani yake zitakatiliwa mbali [na] kuangamia, \q na theluthi itabaki ndani yake.
sw.B: Katika nchi yote, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q theluthi mbili zitakatiliwa mbali na kufa, \q lakini theluthi moja itabaki ndani yake.
sw.R: Katika nchi yote, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q watu wawili kati ya kila watatu watauawa, \q na mmoja tu kati ya watatu ataachwa hai.

vi.L: Sẽ xảy ra trong khắp xứ, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, \q hai phần trong đó sẽ bị diệt trừ [và] chết đi, \q còn phần thứ ba sẽ được để lại trong đó.
vi.B: Trong khắp xứ, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, \q hai phần ba sẽ bị diệt trừ và chết, \q nhưng một phần ba sẽ còn lại.
vi.R: Trong khắp xứ, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, \q cứ ba người thì hai người sẽ bị giết, \q chỉ một người còn sống sót.

ko.L: 온 땅에서 이렇게 될 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. \q 그 가운데 두 몫은 끊어져 죽고, \q 셋째 몫은 그 안에 남을 것이다.
ko.B: 온 땅에서 이렇게 될 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 삼분의 이는 끊어져 죽고, \q 삼분의 일은 그 안에 남을 것이다.
ko.R: 온 땅에서 이렇게 될 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 세 사람 가운데 두 사람은 죽임을 당하고, \q 세 사람 가운데 한 사람만 살아남을 것이다.

decisions.choice: two parts: two-thirds
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "a mouth of two", an idiom for a double share or two portions (Deuteronomy 21:17; 2 Kings 2:9). With "the third" that follows, it means two of three parts.

decisions.choice: two-thirds cut off, one-third left: a remnant survives the judgment
decisions.reason: Ezekiel 5:1-12 divides the people into thirds, with only a few saved. Here the third that is left becomes the purified people of verse 9. The numbers stress how severe the judgment is, and that a remnant remains.

decisions.choice: two parts ... the third (L); two-thirds ... one-third (B); two out of every three ... one out of three (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "two parts"; Balanced and Readable give the fractions (m1). "Declares the LORD" follows the wording set in Isaiah.

source.text: וְהֵבֵאתִ֤י אֶת־הַשְּׁלִשִׁית֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ וּצְרַפְתִּים֙ כִּצְרֹ֣ף אֶת־הַכֶּ֔סֶף וּבְחַנְתִּ֖ים כִּבְחֹ֣ן אֶת־הַזָּהָ֑ב ה֣וּא׀יִקְרָ֣א בִשְׁמִ֗י וַֽאֲנִי֙ אֶעֱנֶ֣ה אֹת֔וֹ אָמַ֨רְתִּי֙ עַמִּ֣י ה֔וּא וְה֥וּא יֹאמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And I will bring the third into the fire, and I will refine them as one refines the silver, and I will test them as one tests the gold. It will call on my name, and I will answer it; I will say, My people [is] it; and it will say, Yahweh [is] my God.

en.L: And I will bring the third into the fire, \q and refine them as one refines silver, \q and test them as one tests gold. \q It will call on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, and I will answer it; \q I will say, "My people [is] it," \q and it will say, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} [is] my God."
en.B: I will bring this third through the fire; \q I will refine them as silver is refined \q and test them as one tests gold. \q They will call on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, and I will answer. \q I will say, "This is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people," \q and they will say, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is my God."
en.R: I will put the third that is left through the fire. \q I will make them pure, as silver is made pure, \q and test them, as gold is tested. \q They will pray to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and I will answer them. \q I will say, "These are {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people." \q And each of them will say, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is my God."

es.L: Y meteré la tercera [parte] en el fuego, \q y los refinaré como se refina la plata, \q y los probaré como se prueba el oro. \q Él invocará {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, y yo le responderé; \q diré: «Mi pueblo [es] él», \q y él dirá: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] mi Dios».
es.B: Haré pasar por el fuego a esta tercera parte; \q los refinaré como se refina la plata \q y los probaré como se prueba el oro. \q Invocarán {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, y yo les responderé. \q Diré: «Este es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo», \q y ellos dirán: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es mi Dios».
es.R: Haré pasar por el fuego a la tercera parte que quede. \q Los purificaré, como se purifica la plata, \q y los probaré, como se prueba el oro. \q Clamarán a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, y yo les responderé. \q Diré: «Ellos son {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo». \q Y cada uno de ellos dirá: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es mi Dios».

fr.L: Et je ferai entrer le tiers dans le feu, \q et je les affinerai comme on affine l’argent, \q et je les éprouverai comme on éprouve l’or. \q Il invoquera {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, et moi, je lui répondrai ; \q je dirai : « Mon peuple, [c’est] lui », \q et il dira : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] mon Dieu. »
fr.B: Je ferai passer ce tiers par le feu ; \q je les affinerai comme on affine l’argent \q et je les éprouverai comme on éprouve l’or. \q Ils invoqueront {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, et je leur répondrai. \q Je dirai : « C’est {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple », \q et ils diront : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est mon Dieu. »
fr.R: Je ferai passer par le feu le tiers qui restera. \q Je les rendrai purs, comme on purifie l’argent, \q et je les éprouverai, comme on éprouve l’or. \q Ils {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} prieront, et je leur répondrai. \q Je dirai : « Ils sont {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple. » \q Et chacun d’eux dira : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est mon Dieu. »

sw.L: Nami nitaileta theluthi hiyo motoni, \q na kuwasafisha kama mtu asafishavyo fedha, \q na kuwajaribu kama mtu ajaribuvyo dhahabu. \q Italiitia jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaijibu; \q nitasema, "Watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} [ndio] hao," \q nayo itasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] Mungu wangu."
sw.B: Nitaipitisha theluthi hii motoni; \q nitawasafisha kama fedha isafishwavyo, \q na kuwajaribu kama mtu ajaribuvyo dhahabu. \q Wataliitia jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawajibu. \q Nitasema, "Hawa ni watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}," \q nao watasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni Mungu wangu."
sw.R: Nitaipitisha motoni theluthi itakayobaki. \q Nitawafanya safi, kama fedha isafishwavyo, \q na kuwajaribu, kama dhahabu ijaribiwavyo. \q Wataniomba, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawajibu. \q Nitasema, "Hawa ni watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}." \q Na kila mmoja wao atasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni Mungu wangu."

vi.L: Ta sẽ đưa phần thứ ba ấy vào lửa, \q luyện họ như người ta luyện bạc, \q và thử họ như người ta thử vàng. \q Nó sẽ kêu cầu danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đáp lời nó; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phán: "Nó [là] dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}," \q và nó sẽ nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] Đức Chúa Trời của tôi."
vi.B: Ta sẽ đưa một phần ba này qua lửa; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ luyện họ như luyện bạc \q và thử họ như thử vàng. \q Họ sẽ kêu cầu danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đáp lời. \q Ta sẽ phán: "Đây là dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}," \q và họ sẽ nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đức Chúa Trời của tôi."
vi.R: Ta sẽ đưa một phần ba còn lại qua lửa. \q Ta sẽ làm cho họ tinh sạch như bạc được luyện sạch, \q và thử họ như vàng được thử. \q Họ sẽ cầu nguyện với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đáp lời họ. \q Ta sẽ phán: "Đây là dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}." \q Và mỗi người trong họ sẽ nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đức Chúa Trời của tôi."

ko.L: 내가 그 셋째 몫을 불 속에 넣어, \q 은을 단련하듯이 그들을 단련하고, \q 금을 시험하듯이 그들을 시험할 것이다. \q 그가 내 이름을 부를 것이고, 나는 그에게 응답할 것이다. \q 내가 "그는 내 백성이다" 하고 말할 것이며, \q 그는 "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 나의 하나님이시다" 하고 말할 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 이 삼분의 일을 불 속으로 지나가게 하여, \q 은을 단련하듯 그들을 단련하고 \q 금을 시험하듯 그들을 시험하겠다. \q 그들이 내 이름을 부르면 내가 응답하겠다. \q 내가 "이들은 내 백성이다" 하고 말하면, \q 그들은 "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 나의 하나님이시다" 하고 말할 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 살아남은 삼분의 일을 불 속으로 지나가게 하겠다. \q 은을 깨끗하게 하듯이 그들을 깨끗하게 하고, \q 금을 시험하듯이 그들을 시험하겠다. \q 그들이 나에게 기도하면 내가 응답하겠다. \q 내가 "이들은 내 백성이다" 하고 말하겠다. \q 그러면 그들은 저마다 "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 나의 하나님이시다" 하고 말할 것이다.

decisions.choice: refine them as silver, test them as gold: the fire purifies
decisions.reason: Silver and gold were melted in a furnace so that the waste rose to the top and could be removed, leaving the pure metal (Proverbs 17:3). The prophets use the picture of God purifying his people through suffering (Isaiah 1:25; 48:10; Malachi 3:2-3; Psalm 66:10). 1 Peter 1:7 uses it of faith tested by trials.

decisions.choice: They are my people ... The LORD is my God: the covenant words spoken again
decisions.reason: These are the words of the covenant between the LORD and Israel (Leviticus 26:12; Jeremiah 31:33). Hosea 1:9 had denied them, and Hosea 2:25 restored them in the same exchange: "You are my people", "My God". The purified remnant is the covenant people again.

decisions.choice: it will call ... it will say: the remnant spoken of as one
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks of "the third" as one person: "it will call", "I will answer it", "my people is it", "it will say, my God". The remnant speaks as one, and the last words, "my God", are each one's confession.

decisions.choice: call on my name (L, B); pray to me (R); my God; each of them (R)
decisions.reason: "Call on the name" of the LORD is to pray to him and worship him (Genesis 4:26; Joel 3:5); Readable says "pray to me". The LORD speaks of his own name and people, so "my" and "me" take the deity_pronoun setting; "my God" is the people's word and takes none. Literal keeps the Hebrew singular, "it"; Balanced and Readable say "they" and "these", and Readable adds "each of them" to explain "my" (m3).

decisions.choice: "él" for the remnant (L); "ellos" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew singular for the third that is left (meaning decision m3); "Mi pueblo" at the start of a quotation is written plainly, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "주는 나의 하나님이시다", with -시- in the people's confession
decisions.reason: God speaks in his own words without the honorific, but the people's confession speaks about him, so it takes -시-.
